༄༅/ /'khrul snang du dpal nā ro pas gnang ba'i tsaṇḍa lī dang 'pho ba zab pa bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// 'khrul snang du dpal nā ro pas gnang ba'i tsaṇḍa lī dang 'pho ba zab pa bzhugs so//

na mo ratna gu ru/ 'dir yang rje chos kyi grags pa'i dag snang du dpal nā ro pas gnang ba'i tsaṇḍa lī dang 'pho ba zab pa ni/ shing pho stag gi lo nag pa zla ba'i nang du/ dge 'dun bcu phrag bdun lhag la/ nā ro'i chos drug gi zab khrid phul zhing*/ bdag kyang zla dgon gyi gtsug lag khang du mgon po mched brgyad kyi bskang ba rgyun sring yod pa'i tshe/ tshes bdun gyi nub rmi lam 'dzin sbyang sprul bsgyur gyi dmigs rkang gi skabs| bdag gis rmi lam zhig bzung nas rgya gar du 'gro snyam pa'i 'dun pa dang bcas gnyid pa'i srod la/ dur khrod chen po 'jigs su rung ba zhig tu slebs pa na/ bud med sngo bsangs smin mtshams su sme ba dmar po 'od rab tu 'phro ba yod pa zhig 'dug pa la/ dur khrod 'di la ci zer ming dris pas/ 'di dpal rga los ma hā kā lā'i grub pa brnyes pa'i sa/ dur khrod chen po bsil ba'i tshal bya ba de yin/ khyod kyang 'dir gsol ba thob cig /mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub gang 'dod pa yod pa yin zer/ brag ri mtshon cha gzengs pa 'dra ba'i ngos la/ dpal mgon phyag bzhi pa'i lha tshogs rnams bskal pa'i me rlung rab tu 'khrugs pa'i klong na/ gar stabs shigs shigs ma 'dres par lam me 'dug pa mjal bas/ gsang ba gsol 'debs dang*/ bskang bshags/ bstod pa mang du byas pas/ bud med des smon lam de tsam gyis chog gi/ da ni the tshom gyi dri ma rnams paṇa chen drung du chod cig /ces gsungs par g.yas phyogs su bltas pas/ pha bong dkar po mnan na nem nem byed pa zhig gi steng du dzo ki smug nag gzhon tshul snum bag dang ldan pa he ru ka'i rgyan can zhig bdag la nan gyis gzigs kyin 'dug par/ bud med des gus gus mang po byed thal mo sbyar zhing*/ paṇa chen nā ro pa yin zer bas/ bdag gi bsam pa la rmi lam yin pa 'dra/ paṇa chen nā ro pa mkha' spyod du gshegs pa'i rgyu mtshan sgra sgyur mar pa'i rnam thar na 'dug snyam paṇa chen nā ro dang mjal ba 'di rmi lam yin nam byas pas/

bud med des/ mkha' spyod ces pa logs na med// 'khor 'das rmi lam nā ro pa// logs su btsal yang rnyed par dka'// thams cad sems su go na rnyed// zer bas bdag gi bsam pa la/ 'di nā ro paṇa chen dngos su bzhugs pa dang 'dra ste/ chos drug tshang ba zhig zhus na kha thag ring ba'i skyon gyis gnyid sad dogs yod pas/ gtum mo dang 'pho ba'i gdams pa zhig zhus na the tshom grol bar 'gyur ro snyam ste/ rang gi lus ngag yid gsum phyag rten du phul te gsol ba btab pas thugs dgyes bzhin pa'i ngang nas 'di skad gsungs/ de'ang dang po bde drod bskyed bya'i phyir// lus gnad tsog pu pus 'khyud skyod byed bsnol// tha mal lus la spyi bo gsang gnas bar// dbu rkyang ro gsum mar sne cha yi dbyibs// yar sne dbu gtsug mtha' gnyis sna bug slebs// tshangs bug thad kar haṃ yig dkar po ste// thur bstan spyi bor rtsa 'dab sum cu gnyis// mgrin par bcu drug dbus bhrūṃ phyogs bzhir ni// aṃ dang dzriṃ khaṃ hūm̐ rnams rtsa mdud dbyibs// snying gar rtsa brgyad dbus māṃ phyogs bzhir ni// lāṃ dang bāṃ tāṃ pāṃ rnams rtsa mdud dbyibs// lte bar rtsa 'dab drug cu rtsa bzhi la// rtsa gsum 'dus mdor dmar cha'i dwangs ma ni// a shad tsaṇḍa lī yi rnam par gsal// g.yas g.yon nang nas sbar zhing sbud pa las// de las me 'bar lte ba'i rtsa mdud grol// yar 'bar snying ga'i yi ge rtsa mdud grol| |slar 'bar mgrin pa'i yi ge rtsa mdud kyang*// grol zhing me lce haṃ la reg pa yis// dkar cha'i rgyun bab mgrin pa snying ga dang*// lte bar sleb cing a shad dag la thim// lus kun bde ba dag gis khyab par bsam// slar yang a shad sbar zhing sbud pa las// de las dmar cha'i rnam pa'i thig le dang*/ gong gi dkar cha 'dres pa'i sa bon de// kṣa yig dkar dmar mdangs can me lces phul// lte ba snying ga mgrin par slebs byas te// me lces ded pas haṃ la thim ma thag

/lus nang thams cad bde bas khyab pa'i ngang*// rtsa gsum lus kyi nang kun me lces gang*// bu ga dgu nas me lce thon ma thag /lus kyi phyi nang me lce'i na bza' can// dmigs pa'i ngang nas steng 'og kha sbyor ba'i// bum can rlung gi ngang la brjod med skyongs| |gal te bde drod chung ba'i skyon srid na// rgya mtsho chen po 'khor lo lan gsum brgyan// ri rab gzengs bstod rgya mtsho'i gting du bskyur// nyi zla gyen bsgril gling bzhi rab tu bgrad| |srin zhal mes po nang du 'ub kyis bsdu// dpung rdeg gzengs dbab pud zur 'phul 'then dang*// gru dpung gcu zhing 'bebs rnams gsum gsum bya// dmigs su rdo rje khu tshur lan gsum bshud// 'di rnams bde drod skye la 'bad rtsol zhing*// dam tshig ras kyi bgo ba ldan byas na// bde drod shugs kyis rab tu skye bar 'gyur// rngul dang thig le phung sel 'khrul 'khor ni// rngul na ha 'bebs rlung sprug dag la 'bad// phung na langs pa'i lus ni phag mo'i dbyibs// grub ma thag par 'bebs sprug bdun res khrems// 'dzag na langs shing rdo rje'i skyil krung ni// bar snang bcas te 'bebs pa bdun gyis bzlog /gzhan yang 'dren 'grems 'khrul 'khor bya 'dod na// gzhan nas bkang bas dga' bzhi'i 'bar 'dzag 'di| |kho nas de wa ku sa'i sa thob 'gyur// gnyis pa 'pho ba'i gdams pa bstan pa ni// rang lus tha mal dbu mar gsal ba yi// yar sne tshangs bug haṃ bkag mar sne smad/ */ spyi bor nā ro he ru ka yi dbyibs// gsal btab rang gi snying gar dbu ma yi// tshigs steng padma'i lte bar sems nyid ni// thig le yungs 'bru tsam zhig gsal btab ste// hika gi sgras bskul thig le 'bar zhing g.yos// haṃ la thug cing slar yang rang sar phab// rtags dang ldan na glod la las sbyor dus// sne gsal hika sgras nā ro'i thugs kar 'phangs// brjod bral don la dar cig mnyam par bzhag

/sbyong dus 'byongs rtags gtad med rig pa 'byung*// man ngag hika la rlung gis kha lo bsgyur// chos drug rtsa ba gtum mo'i gdams pa ste// tshegs med sangs rgyas sgrub la 'pho ba'i gnad// bka' brgyud rjes 'dzin rnams kyi dgongs rgyan 'di// rang gzhan don gnyis sgrub pa'i thabs gcig pu| |gnyug ma lhan cig skyes pa'i tsaṇḍa līs// rang las byung ba'i nor bu rnyed par 'gyur// zhes gsungs shing nā ro pa nyid kyi lus gnad 'khrul 'khor dang bcas pa gnang zhing yid la gcags par gyur to// ////
